task_name: World 123 Task B  -  ASC 810 Intercompany Inventory Profit Elimination, ASC 830 Non-Monetary Basis & Worksheet Tautology Guard
prompt: Review the foreign-exchange rate and consolidation policy schedule, intercompany optical component sales and warehouse inventory records, intercompany loan and fee schedules, and consolidation worksheet control log for Helios Photonics Group in helios_oct2026_multientity_fx_ic_consolidation.xlsx. Compute the embedded intercompany inventory profit and unrealized ending inventory markup under ASC 810, evaluate the ASC 830 exchange-rate basis for non-monetary subsidiary inventory, provide all consolidation elimination journal entries, audit the consolidation worksheet check formula and sign-off controls, and determine the governed October 2026 close status.

rubric.description: Computes embedded intercompany profit on shipment INV-IC-880 ($60,000.00 billed in 4810 Intercompany Component Sales less $45,000.00 manufacturing cost in 5100 Component COGS across 800 units) as $15,000.00, representing a 25.00% gross margin on intercompany sales and a 33.33% markup on cost.

Determines from the 480 units resold externally and 320 units on hand out of 800 units that Helios Canada Ltd. sold 60% ($36,000.00 transfer price in Canada's 5100 Component COGS, realizing $9,000.00 of intercompany profit) and retains 40% ($24,000.00 transfer price = CAD 32,000.00 at the 0.7500 historical spot rate) in ending 1250 Inventory containing $6,000.00 of unrealized intercompany profit.

Provides the ASC 810 consolidation elimination journal entry for INV-IC-880: Dr 4810 Intercompany Component Sales $60,000.00 / Cr 5100 Component COGS $54,000.00 / Cr 1250 Inventory $6,000.00, eliminating 100.00% of intercompany component sales.

Reconciles consolidated ending 1250 Inventory from $24,000.00 standalone down to $18,000.00 true group manufacturing cost (40% of $45,000.00) and consolidated 5100 Component COGS across US ($45,000.00) and Canada ($36,000.00) from $81,000.00 combined standalone down to $27,000.00 true group cost of the 60% sold externally.

Enforces ASC 830 temporal remeasurement for USD-functional Helios Canada Ltd., confirming that non-monetary 1250 Inventory (CAD 32,000.00) must not be revalued at the 0.7200 October 31 closing spot rate to $23,040.00 and must not recognize a false $960.00 FX loss in 7910.

Also confirms consolidated P&L management fee elimination on INV-IC-1026 (Dr 4800 Intercompany Management Fee Revenue $32,550.00 / Cr 6800 Intercompany Management Fee Expense $32,550.00) and intercompany balance sheet elimination (Dr 2350 Intercompany Due To $187,550.00 / Cr 1350 Intercompany Due From $187,550.00) so consolidated 4800, 4810, 6800, 1350, and 2350 all equal $0.00.

Identifies the consolidation worksheet defect on CONSOL-CHK-10 where Elimination_Check_Formula='=US_1350_IC_Due_From - US_1350_IC_Due_From' compares Helios US Inc.'s $92,550.00 unadjusted 1350 balance against itself to report a false $0.00 variance while omitting GmbH and Canada 1350 and 2350 balances and hiding the $16,595.00 pre-audit three-entity imbalance.

Refuses to accept preparer self-attestation Preparer_Status='ELIMINATED' on CONSOL-CHK-10 because Reviewer_Signoff_Receipt is null, the worksheet check formula is self-referential, and $15,000.00 in 1360 Cash in Transit awaits November bank settlement read-back (2026-11-30 true-up deadline), assigning 2026-10 close status closed_with_estimates rather than certified.
